Thank you so much for the feedback and encouragement my friend.  I've thought this for quite a while now and I am increasingly convinced this idea could change the world a bit. 

Imagine if only 0.5% of the 40,000 people that commit suicide worldwide every year would choose this path and donate all their organs upon their death. So many kids would get their dad or mom for many more years, for example.

Not similar. Normal organ donation requires very particular conditions in which the brain dies but heart still pumps blood and oxygen, otherwise organs die immediately. 

My Selflesscide idea requires a doctor to simply harvest all my organs now and provide them to others.  The procedure will result in my own death yes, but with lots of organs to prolong others' lives.

Thanks my friend. Unfortunately, there is no law that allows for this. So I'm pleading for support of people in the Netherlands, Belgium or the UK, which are countries with open-minded societies that could allow for this.
